# PlanRadar

> PlanRadar is a cloud-based construction and real estate management platform serving 120,000+ users across 60+ countries with integrated project management, document handling, and real-time analytics.

PlanRadar provides comprehensive software solutions for construction project management and real estate portfolio administration. The platform operates globally with regional offices and partnerships, offering multilingual support and localized solutions across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East.

## Key Topics

- Construction Management
- Real Estate Software
- Project Management
- Document Management
- Plan Management
- Project Analytics
- SaaS Platform
- Multi-Regional
- Global Offices
- Construction Digitization
- Building Site 4.0
- Property Management
- Project Scheduling
- Real-time Reporting
- Cloud-based Collaboration

## Product & Platform

- [PlanRadar's Platform Overview](https://www.planradar.com/us/platform): PlanRadar platform overview for construction and real estate lifecycle management
- [Construction Management Software](https://www.planradar.com/us/product/construction-management-software): International construction project management software used in 60+ countries
- [Real Estate and Property Management Software](https://www.planradar.com/us/product/real-estate-property-management-software): Real estate and property management software for portfolio administration
- [Construction Plan Management](https://www.planradar.com/us/product/construction-plan-management): Plan management for blueprints and team communication
- [Document Management Software](https://www.planradar.com/us/product/document-management): Document management for real-time sharing and storage across teams
- [Project Analysis & Insights](https://www.planradar.com/us/product/project-analysis-and-insights): Live project insights and analytics with real-time reporting capabilities
- [Project Scheduling](https://www.planradar.com/us/project-scheduling): Project scheduling and planning tool for construction management
